Very off.

hunks.sol: A chill crept up the back of Mr. Kim’s neck. He’d been driving a taxi for more than ten years, but he’d never had this kind of problem customer before.

hunks.baseline: He kept stealing glances at the young man in the passenger seat, and in that moment—
hunks.sol: Just as he stole another glance at the young man in the passenger seat—

hunks.baseline: The young man’s eyes, hollow only a moment ago, were gleaming like a beast’s.
hunks.sol: The young man’s eyes, hollow only a moment ago, now gleamed like a wild beast’s.

hunks.baseline: “A-a truck? A blue one?”
hunks.sol: “A-a truck? The blue one?”

hunks.baseline: Mr. Kim’s eyes darted around, and in the end he gave the answer the young man seemed to want.
hunks.sol: Mr. Kim’s eyes darted around. In the end, he gave the answer the young man seemed to want.

hunks.sol: “I-I’ll turn off up ahead.”

hunks.baseline: The young man hugged the drink box tight until the blue truck disappeared from view. As if someone might snatch it away.
hunks.sol: The young man hugged the drink box tight until the blue truck disappeared from view, as if someone might snatch it away.

hunks.baseline: Of course, he didn’t skip smelling it whenever he got the chance.
hunks.sol: Of course, he kept smelling it whenever he got the chance.

hunks.baseline: The AC was blasting inside the car, but Mr. Kim’s back was soaked with cold sweat.
hunks.sol: The AC was blasting inside the car, but Mr. Kim’s back was soaked in cold sweat.

hunks.sol: And this was his first fare of the day.

hunks.baseline: A thoroughly jinxed day.
hunks.sol: He was thoroughly cursed.

hunks.baseline: Vroom.

hunks.baseline: No. I was coming home for the first time in months. I should drop thoughts like that.

hunks.sol: I glared at the apartment buildings packed together, then pulled out my phone and called. It rang for quite a while before the line finally connected.

hunks.baseline: “I study better when I get up early.”
hunks.sol: “I study better when I wake up early.”

hunks.baseline: “Yeah. But I forgot which place is ours.”
hunks.sol: “Yeah. But I forgot which one is ours.”

hunks.baseline: “……Again? You really do the damnedest things. Wait there.”
hunks.sol: “……Again? You really are something else. Wait there.”

hunks.sol: I stood there holding the dead phone. A few minutes later, a girl appeared at the entrance of one of the buildings, dragging her slippers along.

hunks.baseline: Even from a distance, she radiated total bum energy. That face said the whole world was too much trouble, and I couldn’t help smiling.
hunks.sol: Even from a distance, she radiated the aura of an unemployed bum. One look at that face, which said the whole world was too much trouble, and I couldn’t help smiling.

hunks.baseline: “You come so rarely. The residents’ association president probably visits more than you do.”
hunks.sol: “You come so rarely. The president of the apartment women’s association probably visits more than you do.”

hunks.baseline: Wrinkled hands. A perm half fallen out. She looked as happy as a kid getting a surprise gift.
hunks.sol: Wrinkled hands. A perm half fallen out. She looked as delighted as a little kid receiving a surprise gift.

hunks.baseline: My throat tightened. I scratched my chin, then burst out laughing.
hunks.sol: My throat tightened. I scratched my chin, then broke into a grin.

hunks.baseline: Mom was busy with breakfast in the kitchen. A good smell hung in the air.
hunks.sol: Mom was busy making breakfast in the kitchen. A delicious smell wafted through the air.

hunks.baseline: “Mrs. Kim is really excited now that her son’s home after so long.”
hunks.sol: “Mrs. Kim sure is excited to have her son home after so long.”

hunks.baseline: The old sofa sagged.

hunks.sol: “Yeah. A whole feast. Thanks to you, I’m eating well today.”

hunks.baseline: She answered, but her eyes stayed glued to her phone.

hunks.sol: “I mean, you could at least massage my shoulders after everything I’ve been through.”

hunks.sol: I mean, I’d barely made it back after nearly dying!

hunks.sol: “Go get ready for school, you little school-lunch parasite.”

hunks.sol: “Mm. Today’s the school anniversary.”

hunks.sol: I wanted to smack the back of that irritating head right then and there, but if I did, I’d really lose.

hunks.sol: “Mom! Oppa’s sexually harassing me!”

hunks.baseline: The box flew wide open.

hunks.sol: I smiled awkwardly.

hunks.baseline: Breakfast was probably going to be delayed for quite a while.
hunks.sol: It looked like breakfast was going to be delayed for quite a while.

hunks.baseline: “So that’s how it happened.”
hunks.sol: “So that’s what happened.”

hunks.sol: I sighed and tossed Hayeon my wallet.

hunks.sol: Hayeon eyed me suspiciously, then started digging through the wallet. There was barely anything in it, so it didn’t take her long to find *it*.

hunks.sol: She held up a single card.

hunks.baseline: Despite her words, she seemed to believe me now.
hunks.sol: Despite what she said, she seemed to believe me now.

hunks.sol: The silver gleam of the C-rank Hunter license. The neatly stacked bundles totaling three hundred million won.

hunks.sol: Mom sat there staring blankly and muttered as if groaning.

hunks.sol: “What on earth is happening…?”

hunks.baseline: “I smell burning.”
hunks.sol: “I smell something burning.”

hunks.sol: Mom rushed in after me, stamping her feet in distress.

hunks.sol: “Oh no! What do we do?”

hunks.sol: “Let’s go out to eat. It’s been a while.”
